page.overview:
Who is Kanabun?

Kanabun is a person who, even in a small turmoil that took place in a small town, will not miss the chance of obtaining benefits and sent his people to take bets on the fight between Tsukado and Katazu. He also showed an aggressive side, refusing to acknowledge a draw in battle and directing his men to kill those for whom he lost money. After a small fight, Kanabun and his men fled in fear, promising revenge.

Kanabun has short spiky grey hair and small black eyes. He wears a purple kimono with a belt over which he wears a robe that has a green top and bottom, separated by a red wavy pattern, and a dirty yellow in the middle. The border of the sleeves of the robe is also red. Apart from this, Kanabun wears brown pants and a pair of sandals.

Kanabun seems to be a good leader, as he runs a fairly large group, where all people are armed with swords. Despite this, they lost to two swordsmen and a Konohagakure ninja, and Kanabun himself was pecked by the Condor.

He and his gang watched Tsukado's fight and loss against Katazu who killed his distant relative. After seeing his hidden swordsman's skills after the fight, Kanabun brings Katazu the next day to fight Tsukado so he and his gang can profit off their fight. When Katazu reveals that he didn't kill Shikazo and the fight ends, Kanabun and his gang try to get them fight again by force, but are chased out of town by the two swordsmen, Team 7 and Mr. Ostrich with him saying they'll be sorry.
